verdict.rationale: MoonPay's Web SDK documents a method to remove a stored payment method when a customer asks to forget a card (docs-35), and a method to clear the customer's MoonPay connection in the current browser on sign-out (docs-33). These are narrow deletion controls. Beyond them, the evidence only says MoonPay stores payment and KYC details, with no stated user control over how long they are kept (docs-20). missing for 10: configurable retention policies or periods, account or KYC data deletion, user-facing data export or erasure requests, documentation of the privacy posture, independent corroboration.
